# ALA Library LibGuides

> Comprehensive collection of research guides and library resources curated by the American Library Association covering cataloging, copyright, technology, community services, and professional standards.

ALA Library LibGuides provides librarians and information professionals with authoritative guides on library operations, standards, and best practices. The platform covers technical standards like MARC and RDA, operational topics like interlibrary loans and facility planning, and contemporary issues including information evaluation and community engagement.

## Key Topics

- American Library Association (ALA)
- Library standards and cataloging
- MARC and RDA standards
- Interlibrary loans and resource sharing
- Library technology and automation
- Copyright and intellectual property
- Information evaluation and media literacy
- Public library services
- Library construction and facility planning
- ISBN/ISSN identification systems
- Indigenous librarianship
- Financial literacy programs
- Health information services
- Community engagement
- Book discussion groups

## Library Standards and Technical Tools

- [Cataloging Tools and Resources](https://libguides.ala.org/catalogingtools): Cataloging tools, MARC standards, and RDA guide for librarians
- [ISBN and ISSN Systems](https://libguides.ala.org/isbn-issn): ISBN and ISSN standards for book and serial identification
- [Filing Rules](https://libguides.ala.org/filing-rules): ALA filing rules for catalog organization and alphabetical arrangement
- [Definition of a Library](https://libguides.ala.org/library-definition): Definition of libraries, types, collections, and information services

## Library Operations and Services

- [Implementing Library Technology](https://libguides.ala.org/librarytech): Library automation, ILS, discovery services, and technology implementation
- [Interlibrary Loans](https://libguides.ala.org/Interlibraryloans): Interlibrary loan code, standards, and best practices for resource sharing
- [Building Libraries & Library Additions](https://libguides.ala.org/library-construction): LibGuide on library construction, design, and facility planning
- [Joint-Use Libraries](https://libguides.ala.org/Jointuselibraries): Joint-use library models, collaboration, and decision-making guides
- [Bookmobiles](https://libguides.ala.org/bookmobiles): LibGuide on bookmobiles and mobile library outreach services

## Legal, Intellectual Property, and Information Literacy

- [Copyright for Libraries](https://libguides.ala.org/copyright): Copyright law, fair use, and intellectual property guide for libraries
- [Evaluating Information](https://libguides.ala.org/InformationEvaluation): Guide on information evaluation, media literacy, and fake news detection

## Community Services and Collections

- [Health Information in Libraries](https://libguides.ala.org/health-information): Health information resources, medical literacy, and wellness in libraries
- [Financial Literacy in Public Libraries](https://libguides.ala.org/finra-ore/personalfinance): Financial literacy guide for public libraries with FINRA Foundation
- [Book Discussion Groups](https://libguides.ala.org/bookdiscussiongroups): LibGuide on book discussion groups, book clubs, and facilitation resources
- [Book Donation Programs](https://libguides.ala.org/book-donations): LibGuide on book donation programs and used book resources

## Diversity, Equity, and Social Issues

- [All Nations LibGuide](https://libguides.ala.org/allnations): LibGuide on indigenous librarianship and Native American resources
- [Gun Violence and Libraries](https://libguides.ala.org/gunviolencelibraries): ALA resources on gun violence, workplace safety, and community engagement

## ALA Publications and Resources

- [Index of Titles - American Library Association Periodicals](https://libguides.ala.org/ala-periodicals): Index of ALA periodicals including Knowledge Quest and AASL Digest

## Core Navigation

- [Home](https://libguides.ala.org/home): ALA Library LibGuides homepage with resource guides and library topics
